description.narrative: As part of its portfolio-wide initiatives (pillar 3) the DFC/MASSIF Digital Transformation Technical Assistance Facility (DTX TAF) is proposing to organize a learning experience for c-suite members of institutions receiving funding from the DFC-MASSIF Master Participation Agreement. This project will allow beneficiaries to attend the masterclass “Leadership in the digital age”, which will be collaboratively delivered by INSEAD followed by an exploratory visit to the Singapore Fintech Festival. Therefore, this project seeks to support selected Financial Service Providers in further developing their leadership skills, facilitate peer-to-peer learning, and networking for effective implementation of their digital strategies.
